svg.title: Saskatchewan plate insurance versus a package policy
svg.desc: Plate insurance includes 200,000 dollars of liability. A package policy is a second contract that can raise liability, lower the deductible, and add rental or lease-gap cover. No Fault injury coverage is the default unless a Tort declaration is filed.
svg.text: Plate floor, then the package you choose
SGI plate and injury guides. Liability figure is the published $200,000 floor.
No Fault is automatic. Tort starts only after SGI has your declaration.
Injury benefits under the No Fault guide apply in Canada and the United States. File an injury claim within two years.
The $200,000 can be split among people you injure. A financed vehicle is a reason to price gap and a higher limit.
A farm plate is not a passenger plate. A package on the family car does not follow a truck used for hire.
The package is excess to the plate. Read both documents. There is no single provincial percent to demand.
